meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会扫描你在 Azure 的 Function 应用和 App Service,检查区域冗余、存储冗余、健康探测、多区域故障转移等可靠性配置,输出按功能分类的检查表,并在你确认后分步用命令或代码修改修复。
howto.when: 当你说“评估可靠性”“检查高可用性”“区域冗余”等与可靠性相关的要求时触发。只覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service,不支持 Container Apps。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 Function 应用的可靠性
say.note: 会扫描资源并生成可靠性检查表

say.text: 检查我的 Web 应用是否区域冗余
say.note: 会检查计算和存储的冗余状态

say.text: 给我的应用启用多区域故障转移
say.note: 先评估,再询问是否执行修复

howto.what_en: Claude scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources, checks zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region failover, shows a feature-based checklist, and after your confirmation applies fixes via CLI or IaC patches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to assess reliability, check high availability, zone redundancy, multi-region failover, etc. Covers only Azure Functions and App Service, not Container Apps.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function app
say_en.note: Scans resources and generates a reliability checklist

say_en.text: Check if my web app is zone redundant
say_en.note: Checks zone redundancy status for compute and storage

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app
say_en.note: Assesses first, then asks before making changes
